messages:
Aisha: From the postmortem: we keep seeing the same tail-latency pattern on large-batch traffic. Need concrete playbook edits + owners so these follow-ups don't slip.
Tom: I'll take ownership of the batch-merging guardrails and the throttling play. Plan: add a pre-check and an automated throttle toggle. ETA: next Wed.
Ravi: I'll take the rollback + canary verification steps for model routes and make sure we document exact verification queries. ETA: 72h.
Ops Bot: Incident tag: INF-4722 created. Attached summary in Confluence: https://confluence.internal/redwood/incidents/INF-4722
Lina: Suggest adding a short triage snippet at top of playbook for on-call: quick checks (metrics, backlog, affected models) + who to page. Keeps noisy long playbooks useful in a pager situation.
Aisha: Agreed. Proposed short triage (to be pasted into playbook header):
```
1) Metrics quick-view: `curl -s http://metrics/api/summary | jq .latency_p50, .latency_p95, .batch_queue_length`
2) Check batch-queue per-lane: `redis-cli -h cache-svc LRANGE lane:batch-queue 0 0`
3) If p95 > 1s OR queue > 800 -> flip ingestion throttle: `POST /admin/throttle {"level":"high"}`
4) Verify fallback route active: `curl -s http://routing/api/routes?model=fallback`
5) Run canary traffic to fallback: `ab -n 50 -c 5 http://fallback.internal/health`
6) If GPU OOM suspected: `journalctl -u inference.service | tail -n 200`
```
Tom: For the automated throttle toggle, I'll add a small script and a safety flag in the playbook. Example command: `scripts/toggle_throttle.py --level high --reason "postmortem INF-4722"`
Ravi: For rollback steps, include both k8s and service-level rollbacks:
```
# service route rollback
curl -X POST https://routing.internal/rollback -d '{"service":"inference","to":"previous"}'
# kubernetes rollback
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-worker -n inference-prod --to-revision=2
```
Lina: Escalation policy tweak: add a 2-step notification. Step 1: page on-call SRE for 10m problem window. Step 2: if unresolved after 20m escalate to infra lead + product PM. Add phone numbers and pager priorities.
Aisha: Good. Also add a recurring action in the playbook to run a 3-week incident pattern review: owners review similar postmortems and surface common mitigations. Assigning that to Lina. Due: 2 weeks.
Tom: I'll open PR for playbook edits and include unit tests for the throttle script so we don't ship a toggle that misbehaves. PR will reference INF-4722.
Ravi: I'll attach sample verification queries to the rollback steps (curl + example JSON responses) so on-call can confirm success without digging through logs.
Lina: I'll update the escalation contact list and add the 3-week pattern review item to the action tracker.
Ops Bot: Reminder created: follow-up review scheduled in 14 days. Jira: INF-4722-FWUP.
Aisha: Owner summary for tracker:
- Tom: batch-merging guardrails + throttle script + PR (due Wed next week)
- Ravi: rollback & canary verification + docs (due in 72h)
- Lina: escalation contacts + 3-week pattern review owner (due in 14 days)
Aisha: Please paste PR + Jira links here as you open them so I can mark items closed in the tracker. If anything slips, we'll escalate in the next oncall sync.
Tom: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference-playbooks/pull/425 (adds throttle script + tests)
Ravi: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops-docs/pull/92 (rollback + verification examples)
Lina: Added pattern-review task to tracker: https://jira.internal/browse/INF-4722-FWUP
Aisha: Thanks everyone 44d. Closing thread for async updates; keep the Jira / action tracker authoritative.
